householdIds.label: Households to synchronize
householdIds.help: Leave empty to synchronize every household the token can see

slowPollFactor.label: Read recipes and the catalog every
slowPollFactor.help: These two are by far the largest reads and change rarely. 1 reads them on every poll.

syncCatalog.label: Item catalog, categories and tags
syncCatalog.help: Stored as JSON states. Can be several hundred entries per household.

createRecipeObjects.label: Create a state tree per recipe
createRecipeObjects.help: If disabled, recipes are only exposed as a single JSON state

createShoppingItemObjects.label: Create a state tree per shopping list item
createShoppingItemObjects.help: If disabled, list items are only exposed as a single JSON state

deleteStaleObjects.label: Delete objects that disappeared in KitchenOwl
deleteStaleObjects.help: Keeps the object tree in sync when lists, recipes or members are removed

cachePhotos.label: Download photos so a visualization can show them
cachePhotos.help: KitchenOwl serves photos only with the API token, which a browser does not send. A copy is kept with the adapter and downloaded once per photo.
